title: The Ownership Map v1 has no table for rwb-valuation although Architecture v5 names valuations, the D6 route decision and the route agent output
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S1 Valuation and route v2.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Physical Schema v6.sql
section: Ownership Map v1 Tables sheet; Architecture v5 slide 41 row S1; TSD S1 v2 T3.1; Physical Schema v6
description: Architecture v5 slide 41 gives S1 rwb-valuation the resources 'valuations, D6 route decision, route agent output'. title: The stack versions of the service template are not pinned in any source read for this work package
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
section: Slides 20 and 38 (service template parts); slide 47 references
description: Architecture v5 names the parts of the service template (Spring Boot, outbox relay, inbox, Temporal worker, codec, OpenTelemetry, contract tests) and pins Temporal 1.30 or later and KEDA 2.17 or later for the scaler, but it pins no Spring Boot version, no Java runtime, no base image, no PostgreSQL driver and no Drools runtime. The Service Template Specification states the parts and carries the §R9 placeholder for the versions.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 20: 'Every service: built from one template (Spring Boot, outbox relay, inbox, Temporal worker, codec, OpenTelemetry, contract tests).' Slide 38: 'Temporal 1.30+'. No version for the other parts appears in the read set.
proposed: Pin the Spring Boot, Java runtime, base image, PostgreSQL driver and Drools versions in Wave 0 and record them in the template's version file and in the Environment and Deployment Design.
